# Task: PR #7261 review fixes — worker map (#7187, parent #7177). Same authoring lane (cursor).

Evidence rule (#M-4): back every claim with a command you ran. You are attached to `cursor/monitor-7187-worker-map` (head b4148f6b77).
Do not rebase or force-push; commit on top. PUSH before you finish and end with `git status -sb` showing the branch is not ahead
of origin. Do NOT claim "ruff clean" unless `.venv/bin/ruff check <every changed .py file>` printed "All checks passed!" — the previous
report claimed it while 10 errors existed (CI only lints scripts/, so run it yourself on tests/ too).

## Review of record (GPT seat) — VERDICT: REQUEST_CHANGES. Findings verbatim:
Findings:
- `tests/api/test_fleet_workers.py:3-25,207; tests/api/test_fleet_workers_unmocked.py:3-7; tests/test_fleet_dashboard_contract.py:138` — blocker — Required Ruff validation fails with 10 errors, including import violations, unused imports, an unused loop variable, and undefined `pytest`.
- `scripts/api/occupancy_sanitize.py:12-13; scripts/api/fleet_workers_models.py:17,26-37; scripts/api/fleet_workers_collect.py:105-106,163-173; scripts/api/main.py:169-175` — major — Source IDs permit 128 characters while `WorkerRow.id` permits 64; construction is uncaught. A 65-character task fixture produced HTTP 500 with raw `ValidationError`/`input_value` detail.
- `scripts/api/occupancy_local.py:183-190` — major — A marker with neither `expires_at` nor `updated_at` is treated as fresh indefinitely, violating the within-TTL liveness rule. Direct probe returned `True`.
- `tests/api/test_fleet_workers.py:186-195; scripts/api/atlas_jobs_router.py:225-294` — major — The G test patches only two functions; `_get_host_load_entry_async` and `_schedule_host_load_refresh` remain unguarded, so an occupancy-probing regression could pass.
- `tests/api/test_fleet_workers.py:168-176; scripts/api/project_state_store.py:93-97` — major — The stale-report test checks only status/detail, not that the newer stored report remains unchanged.
- `scripts/api/fleet_workers_collect.py:79-82; tests/api/test_fleet_workers.py:151-165` — major — The implementation hashes correctly, but the test supplies arbitrary run IDs and never asserts `sha256(run_nonce)[:8]`; a wrong-hash mutation would pass.
- `tests/api/test_fleet_workers.py:198-215` — major — The liveness test leaves `expected` unused and has no disallowed-status fixture; its `"done-1"` assertion is vacuous.
- `scripts/api/fleet_workers_sanitize.py:71-76` — minor — `validate_workers_list([None])` silently returns `[]` instead of rejecting the malformed row.
Commands and results:

## Main's findings (verified on b4148f6b77)
- `hosts` in `GET /api/fleet/workers/v1` is an object keyed by host id; the frozen contract (r3/r2) says `hosts[]` is a LIST of
  `{host_id, freshness, workers_status, workers[], unattributed_burn, reason}`. Align with the contract (list), update fleet.html,
  docs, contract tests accordingly.
- The API host itself must list its in-process delegate workers (its local `batch_state/tasks` with status spawning|running) with
  `workers_status: "reported"` — never `unreported` for the self host. Add an unmocked test with a fixture batch_state on the self host.

## Outcome
Every reviewer finding fixed with a mutation-checked test; ruff clean on ALL changed files (scripts/ and tests/); r3 A–G fully met;
`hosts` is a list; self host reports its own workers; no 500 on any oversized/malformed input (400 or drop-with-count, never raw
ValidationError on the wire).

## Required tests (mutation-checked — revert the fix → the test must fail)
- oversized source id (65+ chars) → route stays 200 and the row is dropped with a counted `skipped` reason (or truncated by a stated
  rule), never 500; same for `validate_workers_list([None])` → rejected, not `[]`.
- marker with neither `expires_at` nor `updated_at` → NOT live (not a worker); marker within TTL → live; past TTL → not reported.
- no-probe test guards `_get_host_load_entry_async` and `_schedule_host_load_refresh` too (assert never called).
- stale-report test asserts the stored newer report is byte-identical after the 409.
- run_id test asserts `sha256(run_nonce)[:8]` for a known nonce; wrong-hash mutation must fail.
- liveness matrix test uses `expected` in the assertion and includes a disallowed status (`done`, `failed`) → not reported.
- `hosts` list shape + self-host `reported` unmocked test.

## Steps
1. `git log -1` must show b4148f6b77. Reproduce: `.venv/bin/ruff check $(git diff --name-only origin/main..HEAD | grep '\.py$')` → 10 errors.
2. Fix all; run `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/api tests/test_fleet_dashboard_contract.py tests/test_lint_test_assertions.py tests/api/test_import_pinning.py tests/test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py`
   and ruff on every changed file (scripts/ AND tests/); paste the unmocked `TestClient` GET output (`/api/fleet/workers/v1`, self host with fixture batch_state).
3. Conventional commit(s) (`fix(fleet): …`) with the `X-Agent` trailer; push to `cursor/monitor-7187-worker-map`.
4. Report: commit SHA(s), passing pytest line, ruff line, one sentence per finding, `git status -sb`.
